regions.merged_text: Noreen Kingsley of 419 Parent Ave., Windsor - Enrolled a year ago as a perpetual member. Then in a dying condition from abscesses of the lungs - a positively hopeless case comes To-day in perfect health. Whereas doctors predicted when she turned for improvement, that she would never be able to do anything, she was teaching school six weeks after enrollment.
